# Nürnberg Renegades e.V.

> Nürnberg Renegades e.V. is a flag football club in Nürnberg, Germany, fielding two teams: the 1st team competes in the 1. DFFL (Germany's top division) and the 2nd team plays in the Bayernliga. No sign-up or contact is required to try it out — newcomers can just drop in to any training session.

This file helps AI agents and language models understand the site structure and locate the club's official pages.

The site is published in two languages: German at the root (`/training`) and English under an `/en` prefix (`/en/training`). The pages below link to the German originals; prefix any path with `/en` for the English version.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.nuernberg-renegades.de/): Club overview, both teams, and how to join.
- [Team](https://www.nuernberg-renegades.de/team): Coaching staff and player roster.
- [Club](https://www.nuernberg-renegades.de/club): Club history, leadership, membership, and how to apply.
- [Training](https://www.nuernberg-renegades.de/training): Training times, locations, and drop-in tryouts — no sign-up needed, just show up.
- [Results](https://www.nuernberg-renegades.de/ergebnisse): Schedules and standings for both teams.
- [Sponsoring](https://www.nuernberg-renegades.de/sponsoring): Sponsorship information and current partners.
- [FAQ](https://www.nuernberg-renegades.de/faq): Frequently asked questions about membership, cost, and the club.
- [Contact](https://www.nuernberg-renegades.de/contact): Contact form and email address.

## Optional

- [Impressum](https://www.nuernberg-renegades.de/impressum): Legal notice.
- [Datenschutz](https://www.nuernberg-renegades.de/datenschutz): Privacy policy.
